data.one_liner: Dart implementation of the Prometheus client library providing metrics.
data.what_it_does: Provides Prometheus metric types like counters, gauges, histograms, and summaries for Dart applications. Allows registering and collecting metrics to export them in the standard text format.
use_when: You need to instrument a Dart backend or server application with Prometheus metrics
You want to expose runtime and custom metrics for scraping
avoid_when: You are building a client-side Flutter app without a backend server endpoint for scraping metrics
strengths: Supports standard Prometheus metric types (Counter, Gauge, Histogram, Summary)
Includes plug-in ready metrics for the Dart runtime
Allows dynamic metric updates using collect callbacks
weaknesses: Limited set of runtime metrics compared to other languages due to Dart platform limitations
